mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rates above 0.3 percentage points in a month triggers risk aversion, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not negative despite UNRATE crossing the 0.3pp threshold in >70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (HOUST) signals robust demand-side expansion, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when both proxies rise simultaneously in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an unexpected drop in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals policy surprise, leading to compressed discount rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive despite FEDFUNDS falling below 4.0% in the tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing of the industrial production index above 105 (5% growth from 2017 baseline) indicates robust supply-side expansion, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when INDPRO crosses above 105 in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates paired with falling unemployment rates create conflicting signals, triggering risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises while UNRATE falls in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS up and UNRATE down in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects robust supply chain activity, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive over 60 days despite sustained INDPRO increases in >70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in monthly job growth (PAYEMS) during a late-cycle labor market expansion signals overheating, prompting market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not negative despite PAYEMS spikes in >80% of late-cycle instances.
